posts.author: Jerry John
posts.content:
Finesse Global hiring "Business Analyst – Banking Domain"

Location: United Arab Emirates (Dubai)
Employment Type: Contract – 6 Months and extendable
Immediate and locally available candidates preferred
 
Role Overview:
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Senior Business Analyst to support strategic transformation initiatives across multiple banking domains. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical capabilities, deep banking domain expertise, and proven experience managing end-to-end business analysis activities within complex financial environments.

Key Responsibilities
Ø  Business Analysis & Requirements Management
o   Lead end-to-end requirements gathering through stakeholder workshops, interviews, and process walkthroughs.
o   Elicit, document, and validate Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), user stories, and non-functional requirements.
o   Develop process models, use cases, workflow diagrams, and data mappings.
o   Ensure requirement traceability across the full project lifecycle.
o   Align requirements with business strategy, regulatory obligations, and system constraints.
 
Required Skills & Competencies

o   Strong understanding of Core Banking Systems and Digital Banking platforms.
o   Working knowledge of SQL and enterprise RDBMS concepts.
o   Experience with Agile tools such as JIRA, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
o   Understanding of APIs, system integrations, workflow engines, and middleware.
o   Ability to perform data analysis, reconciliation, and system log interpretation.
o   Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and Waterfall delivery methodologies.

Experience Requirements
Minimum 8 years of experience as a Business Analyst. Banking or Financial Services Domain is preferred.
Proven expertise in at least one major banking domain (Retail, Corporate, Treasury, Digital Banking, Cards and Payments).

Interested candidates please share your updated resume on jerry@finessedirect.com
